// Package moba 是单路、每队一名英雄的 MOBA 教学纵切。规则仅属于业务，不是框架默认玩法。
package moba

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"

	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/lockstep"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/sync/nettransport"
)

const (
	Idle byte = iota
	Move
	Attack
	Cast
	Buy
)
const (
	HeroTarget byte = iota
	CreepTarget
	TowerTarget
	BaseTarget
)
const MaxFrames lockstep.FrameID = 600

var ErrRule = errors.New("moba: invalid command, checkpoint or frame")

// Command 不含客户端可自报的玩家 ID、伤害、金币或胜负，身份由已鉴权会话绑定 seat。
type Command struct {
	Action, Target byte
	Step           int8
}

func Decode(raw []byte) (Command, error) {
	if len(raw) != 3 {
		return Command{}, ErrRule
	}
	c := Command{raw[0], raw[1], int8(raw[2])}
	switch c.Action {
	case Idle:
		if c.Target != 0 || c.Step != 0 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	case Move:
		if c.Target != 0 || c.Step < -1 || c.Step > 1 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	case Attack, Cast:
		if c.Target > BaseTarget || c.Step != 0 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	case Buy:
		if c.Target != 0 || c.Step != 0 {
			return c, ErrRule
		}
	default:
		return c, ErrRule
	}
	return c, nil
}
func Encode(c Command) []byte { return []byte{c.Action, c.Target, byte(c.Step)} }

type Hero struct {
	X          int64
	HP         int64
	Mana       int64
	Gold       int64
	Kills      int64
	RespawnAt  lockstep.FrameID
	SkillReady lockstep.FrameID
}
type Creep struct{ X, HP int64 }
type State struct {
	Tick   lockstep.FrameID
	Heroes [2]Hero
	Creeps [2]Creep
	Towers [2]int64
	Bases  [2]int64
	Ended  bool
	Winner int64 // 0 表示无胜者，1 / 2 对应 seat，终态只由服务器参考模拟产生。
}

func NewState() *State {
	return &State{Heroes: [2]Hero{{X: 0, HP: 100, Mana: 20}, {X: 10, HP: 100, Mana: 20}}, Towers: [2]int64{40, 40}, Bases: [2]int64{60, 60}}
}
func home(team int) int64 {
	if team == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return 10
}
func tower(team int) int64 {
	if team == 0 {
		return 2
	}
	return 8
}
func distance(a, b int64) int64 {
	if a > b {
		return a - b
	}
	return b - a
}

// Apply 只接受正式排序器产生的连续帧；先校验全部语法与 seat，再修改状态。
// 固定座位顺序解决交互顺序，所有数值为整数，不读墙上时间、不使用 map 遍历或外部随机源。
func (s *State) Apply(frame lockstep.Frame) error {
	if s.Ended || frame.ID != s.Tick+1 || frame.ID > MaxFrames {
		return ErrRule
	}
	commands := make([]Command, len(frame.Inputs))
	last := lockstep.PlayerID(0)
	for i, input := range frame.Inputs {
		if input.Player < 1 || input.Player > 2 || input.Player <= last {
			return ErrRule
		}
		last = input.Player
		c, err := Decode(input.Payload)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		commands[i] = c
	}
	s.Tick = frame.ID
	for team := range 2 {
		h := &s.Heroes[team]
		if h.HP == 0 && s.Tick >= h.RespawnAt {
			h.HP = 100
			h.Mana = 20
			h.X = home(team)
			h.RespawnAt = 0
		}
	}
	for i, input := range frame.Inputs {
		if s.Ended {
			break
		}
		s.command(int(input.Player)-1, commands[i])
	}
	if !s.Ended {
		s.creeps()
		s.turrets()
	}
	if s.Tick == MaxFrames && !s.Ended {
		s.Ended = true
	} // 样例到时无结果，交业务按无奖励终态收口。
	return nil
}
func (s *State) command(team int, c Command) {
	hero := &s.Heroes[team]
	enemy := 1 - team
	if hero.HP == 0 {
		return
	}
	switch c.Action {
	case Idle:
		return
	case Move:
		hero.X = max(int64(0), min(int64(10), hero.X+int64(c.Step)))
		return
	case Buy:
		if hero.Gold >= 5 && hero.HP < 100 {
			hero.Gold -= 5
			hero.HP = min(int64(100), hero.HP+20)
		}
		return
	}
	reach, damage := int64(1), int64(10)
	if c.Action == Cast {
		if hero.Mana < 5 || s.Tick < hero.SkillReady {
			return
		}
		reach = 3
		damage = 25
	}
	targetX := s.Heroes[enemy].X
	switch c.Target {
	case CreepTarget:
		targetX = s.Creeps[enemy].X
	case TowerTarget:
		targetX = tower(enemy)
	case BaseTarget:
		targetX = home(enemy)
	}
	if distance(hero.X, targetX) > reach {
		return
	}
	if c.Target == HeroTarget && s.Heroes[enemy].HP == 0 || c.Target == CreepTarget && s.Creeps[enemy].HP == 0 || c.Target == TowerTarget && s.Towers[enemy] == 0 || c.Target == BaseTarget && (s.Towers[enemy] != 0 || s.Bases[enemy] == 0) {
		return
	}
	if c.Action == Cast {
		hero.Mana -= 5
		hero.SkillReady = s.Tick + 3
	}
	switch c.Target {
	case HeroTarget:
		s.damageHero(enemy, damage)
		if s.Heroes[enemy].HP == 0 {
			hero.Gold += 10
			hero.Kills++
		}
	case CreepTarget:
		s.Creeps[enemy].HP = max(int64(0), s.Creeps[enemy].HP-damage)
		if s.Creeps[enemy].HP == 0 {
			hero.Gold += 5
		}
	case TowerTarget:
		s.Towers[enemy] = max(int64(0), s.Towers[enemy]-damage)
		if s.Towers[enemy] == 0 {
			hero.Gold += 20
		}
	case BaseTarget:
		s.Bases[enemy] = max(int64(0), s.Bases[enemy]-damage)
		if s.Bases[enemy] == 0 {
			s.Ended = true
			s.Winner = int64(team + 1)
		}
	}
}
func (s *State) damageHero(team int, damage int64) {
	h := &s.Heroes[team]
	if h.HP == 0 {
		return
	}
	h.HP = max(int64(0), h.HP-damage)
	if h.HP == 0 {
		h.RespawnAt = s.Tick + 5
	}
}
func (s *State) creeps() {
	for team := range 2 {
		c := &s.Creeps[team]
		enemy := 1 - team
		if c.HP == 0 {
			if s.Tick%6 == 0 {
				c.HP = 20
				c.X = home(team)
			}
			continue
		}
		if distance(c.X, s.Heroes[enemy].X) <= 1 && s.Heroes[enemy].HP > 0 {
			s.damageHero(enemy, 4)
			continue
		}
		if s.Towers[enemy] > 0 && distance(c.X, tower(enemy)) <= 1 {
			s.Towers[enemy] = max(int64(0), s.Towers[enemy]-5)
			continue
		}
		direction := int64(1)
		if team == 1 {
			direction = -1
		}
		c.X = max(int64(0), min(int64(10), c.X+direction))
	}
}
func (s *State) turrets() {
	for team := range 2 {
		if s.Towers[team] == 0 {
			continue
		}
		enemy := 1 - team
		if s.Creeps[enemy].HP > 0 && distance(s.Creeps[enemy].X, tower(team)) <= 1 {
			s.Creeps[enemy].HP = max(int64(0), s.Creeps[enemy].HP-5)
		} else if distance(s.Heroes[enemy].X, tower(team)) <= 1 {
			s.damageHero(enemy, 5)
		}
	}
}

// Snapshot 是业务检查点。客户端从帧 1 追帧可重算状态；已裁历史不会自动从该检查点恢复。
// 存盘和同步这个检查点的身份 / 输入位置必须由宿主另行设计，本例只演示成对恢复模拟状态。
func (s *State) Snapshot() []byte {
	raw, err := json.Marshal(struct {
		Version int
		State   State
	}{1, *s})
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return raw
}
func Restore(raw []byte) (*State, error) {
	if len(raw) > 8192 {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	var saved struct {
		Version int
		State   State
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&saved); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := decoder.Decode(new(any)); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	s := saved.State
	if saved.Version != 1 || s.Tick > MaxFrames || s.Winner < 0 || s.Winner > 2 || !s.Ended && s.Winner != 0 {
		return nil, ErrRule
	}
	for i, h := range s.Heroes {
		if h.HP < 0 || h.HP > 100 || h.Mana < 0 || h.Mana > 20 || h.X < 0 || h.X > 10 || h.Gold < 0 || h.Gold > 100000 || h.Kills < 0 || s.Towers[i] < 0 || s.Towers[i] > 40 || s.Bases[i] < 0 || s.Bases[i] > 60 || s.Creeps[i].HP < 0 || s.Creeps[i].HP > 20 || s.Creeps[i].X < 0 || s.Creeps[i].X > 10 {
			return nil, ErrRule
		}
	}
	return &s, nil
}
func (s *State) Digest() string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(s.Snapshot())
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func (s *State) Hash() uint64 {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(s.Snapshot())
	return binary.BigEndian.Uint64(sum[:8])
}

// Submit 在已经鉴权并绑定 seat 的串行 Match 所有者上调用。字节长度准入不等于业务语法验证。
func Submit(match *lockstep.Match, session uint64, frameID lockstep.FrameID, raw []byte) error {
	if _, err := Decode(raw); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// 超过业务允许的 2 帧迟到便拒绝，不把有限 ReplayHorizon 当作无限期输入幂等。
	next := match.NextFrame()
	if frameID < next && next-frameID > 2 {
		return ErrRule
	}
	return match.HandleCommand(nettransport.SessionID(session), lockstep.Command{Operation: lockstep.OpInput, Frame: frameID, Payload: raw})
}

// 只在 Result 能由服务器参考模拟确认时进入资产结算；客户端 hash 相同并不证明没有作弊。
func (s *State) Result() (int64, string, error) {
	if !s.Ended {
		return 0, "", fmt.Errorf("%w: match still running", ErrRule)
	}
	return s.Winner, s.Digest(), nil
}
